content_sections.heading: RBI Pharmacist Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Register for Job Alerts ↗ Official Notification PDF Applications must reach the RBI Mumbai Regional Office by 3 November 2026 at 5 PM. Candidates must submit the prescribed application form with supporting documents and also furnish the required details through the link mentioned in the notification. Maharashtra State Pharmacy Council registration is mandatory.

content_sections.heading: RBI Mumbai Pharmacist at a Glance

rows.details: Reserve Bank of India (RBI), Mumbai Office
Rs. 600/- per hour (Maximum Rs. 3,000/- per day)
Matriculation plus Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Pharmacy

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent in a sealed cover super-scribed as ‘Application for the post of Pharmacist on contract basis with fixed hourly remuneration, Mumbai’ to the following postal address: The Regional Director, Human Resource Management Department, Recruitment Section, Reserve Bank of India, Mumbai Regional Office, Shahid Bhagat Singh Road, Fort, Mumbai – 400001 Candidates must use the prescribed application format given in Annex-I of the notification. Incomplete applications, applications not in the prescribed format, or applications unaccompanied by copies of requisite documents and certificates will be summarily rejected. Applicants must also ensure that the requisite details are filled in through the official link provided by the Bank.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Matriculation or its equivalent examination. Minimum qualification of Diploma in Pharmacy from a recognized University registered under the Pharmacy Act, 1948, OR Bachelor’s Degree (B. Pharm) in Pharmacy. Must be registered with the Maharashtra State Pharmacy Council. Minimum experience of two (02) years as a Pharmacist. Experience with any PSBs, PSUs, or Government Organizations will be given preference. Basic working knowledge of computers is required. Not specified in the notification.

rows.pay: Rs. 600/- per hour (Max Rs. 5,000/- per day - wait, max Rs. 3,000/- per day)

content_sections.heading: RBI Mumbai Pharmacist Job Description
content_sections.text: To work in any of the Bank’s dispensaries located within the jurisdiction of Mumbai and Navi Mumbai during working hours. To attend dispensaries for a maximum period of five (05) hours per day as per the requirements of the Bank. To maintain strict secrecy regarding the Bank's affairs and serve the Bank honestly and loyally with high integrity. To comply with and obey all orders and directions issued by authorised Bank employees.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopies of Professional, Academic, and Other qualifications. Caste certificate in the prescribed proforma ONLY, meant for appointment under the Government of India (if seeking reservation as SC, ST, or OBC). For OBC candidates, certificate must be issued after April 01, 2026, with Non-Creamy Layer clause. For EWS candidates, an Income and Asset Certificate for Financial Year 2025-26 valid for Year 2026-27. Experience certificate(s). Age proof (such as Matriculation certificate). Copy of registration certificate issued by the Maharashtra State Pharmacy Council.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of overall educational qualifications (PG, Degree, Diploma), distance of residence from various Bank’s dispensaries, and experience with PSBs, PSUs, Government organizations, or RBI. Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. Candidates shortlisted after the interview will be subjected to a medical examination and document verification process before being placed on a panel for engagement as and when requirements arise.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The offer of engagement is for a maximum period of 240 days at a stretch. Remuneration is fixed at Rs. 600/- per hour with a maximum of five (05) hours per day, not exceeding Rs. 3,000/- per day, with no additional pay or allowances. Services rendered will not confer any right for a temporary or permanent post in the Bank’s service. Selected candidates must sign an agreement with the Bank, including a Non-Disclosure clause and Code of Conduct (Annex II). No TA, DA, or allowances will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for RBI Mumbai Pharmacist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 22 vacancies (SC: 1, ST: 1, OBC: 5, EWS: 2, GEN/UR: 13).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 3 November 2026 by 1700 hrs.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation or its equivalent, and possess a Diploma in Pharmacy or Bachelor’s Degree (B. Pharm) in Pharmacy, along with registration with the Maharashtra State Pharmacy Council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the hourly remuneration offered for the Pharmacist post?
faq.answer: Selected pharmacists will be paid a fixed remuneration of Rs. 600/- per hour, up to a maximum of 5 hours per day (not exceeding Rs. 3,000/- per day).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must fill out the application format given in Annex-I, attach self-attested photocopies of required documents, and send it by post or in person to the Regional Director, Human Resource Management Department, Reserve Bank of India, Mumbai, while also filling out the details through the online link.

faq.question: Q6. Is experience mandatory for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants require a minimum experience of two (02) years as a Pharmacist, with preference given to experience in PSBs, PSUs, or Government Organizations.

faq.question: Q7. What is the duration of the engagement contract?
faq.answer: The offer of engagement will be for a maximum period of 240 days at a stretch on a contract/need basis.

faq.question: Q8. Will I be entitled to regular employee benefits or allowances?
faq.answer: No, pharmacists engaged on contract will not be regular employees of the Bank and will not be entitled to any facilities, additional pay, or allowances other than the fixed hourly remuneration.
